mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5) indicate a stagflationary regime where central banks face a policy dilemma, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong employment growth signals robust corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, which typically leads to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown across both consumer and industrial sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1300 and INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), rising industrial production signals strong manufacturing activity and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly.
